items.source: Send a message to the given user.
items.translation: 向给定的用户发送消息。

items.source: user - the user that should receive the message (must not be null)
items.translation: user - 应接收消息的用户（不能为 null）

items.source: destination - the destination to send the message to (must not be null)
items.translation: destination - 消息发送的目标（不能为 null）

items.source: postProcessor - a postProcessor to post-process or modify the created message
items.translation: postProcessor - 一个用于后处理或修改已创建消息的 postProcessor。

items.source: For more on user destinations see UserDestinationResolver.
items.translation: 有关用户目标的更多信息，请参阅 UserDestinationResolver。

items.source: Generally it is expected the user is the one authenticated with the WebSocket session (or by extension the user authenticated with the handshake request that started the session). However if the session is not authenticated, it is also possible to pass the session id (if known) in place of the user name. Keep in mind though that in that scenario, you must use one of the overloaded methods that accept headers making sure the sessionId header has been set accordingly.
items.translation: 通常预期用户是 WebSocket 会话的认证方（或者更广泛地说，是发起该会话的握手请求的认证方）。然而，如果会话未进行认证，也可以将已知的会话 ID 作为用户名传入。不过请注意，在这种情况下，您必须使用接受标头的重载方法之一，并确保已正确设置sessionId标头。

items.source: By default headers are interpreted as native headers (for example, STOMP) and are saved under a special key in the resulting Spring Message. In effect when the message leaves the application, the provided headers are included with it and delivered to the destination (for example, the STOMP client or broker).
items.translation: 默认情况下，标头被解释为原生标头（例如 STOMP），并保存在生成的 Spring Message 的特殊键下。实际上，当消息离开应用程序时，提供的标头会随其一起包含在内并传递到目标位置（例如 STOMP 客户端或代理）。

items.source: Note: if the MessageHeaders are mutable as in the above example, implementations of this interface should take notice and update the headers in the same instance (rather than copy or re-create it) and then set it immutable before sending the final message.
items.translation: 注意： 如果 MessageHeaders 是可变的（如上例所示），此接口的实现应予以注意，并在同一实例中更新这些标头（而不是复制或重新创建它），然后在发送最终消息之前将其设置为不可变。

items.source: See MessageSendingOperations.convertAndSend(Object, Object, java.util.Map) for important notes regarding the input headers.
items.translation: 有关输入标头的注意事项，请参阅 MessageSendingOperations.convertAndSend(Object, Object, java.util.Map)。
